about: The owner adds a voice button to the page's AI inputs: press to record (5 minute limit), the words appear in the box, and sending gives them to the agent as usual; transcription uses Groq's free models, rotating when one hits a rate limit or fails; the Groq key goes in the secrets (stored under the key name GROQ_API_KEY; the value is not written here).
changes_when: Never in the owner's words; only its answer and what it was processed into are added once its knowledge is placed.

update_with.how: Keep its row (summary, categories, processed_into, answered) the same as this file.
